title: Add RecipeBottomBar with action buttons and scale picker
description: Create RecipeBottomBar.swift. A horizontal bar containing: 'Add to menu' button (bookmark SF Symbol, label 'Add to menu'); 'Add to shopping list' button (cart SF Symbol, label 'Add to shopping list'); and a Picker bound to the external Scale binding. Each button presents a system .alert stating 'Coming in a future update' — the alert must not imply the action succeeded. Both buttons carry explicit accessibility labels.
acceptance_criteria: 'Add to menu' button shows bookmark icon with 'Add to menu' label.
'Add to shopping list' button shows cart icon with 'Add to shopping list' label.
Tapping either button presents a system alert with title 'Coming in a future update'.
Alert wording does not imply the action succeeded.
Scale picker binds to the external Scale binding passed in.
Both buttons have explicit accessibility labels.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeBottomBar.swift per spec: horizontal HStack with two action buttons and a scale Picker. Alert title is 'Coming in a future update' with message 'This feature is not available yet.' — phrasing is neutral and does not suggest success. Picker reuses the same RecipeScale.allCases / tag pattern established in IngredientsView. Accessibility labels set on both buttons. Follows UI guidelines: SF Symbols, semantic colors, standard SwiftUI controls, iOS 17 target, no hardcoded sizes or colours.
handoff_summary.remaining: Visual layout verification (icon + label rendering, Picker placement in the bar) is a manual task — cannot be confirmed without running the UI. The bar is not yet embedded in a parent view; a follow-up bead or the recipe detail screen integration will wire it in.
handoff_summary.risks: RecipeBottomBar is a standalone component not yet embedded in any parent screen. Until it is integrated, the Picker's scale binding has no upstream owner — this is expected at this stage of the pipeline.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify accessibility labels, alert presentation, and Picker binding behaviour via unit or UI tests.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No overlap with other in-progress beads; RecipeBottomBar.swift is a new file with no edits to existing files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Picker placed between the two buttons for visual balance. Alert message 'This feature is not available yet.' chosen to be clearly informational without implying the action succeeded or is queued. Picker label style left as default (.menu) to match the pattern used in IngredientsView.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests exist yet for RecipeBottomBar. Tester bead should cover: alert presentation on each button tap, alert title/message wording, Picker binding two-way update, and accessibility label presence.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Visual layout not verified (agent cannot render UI). RecipeBottomBar is not yet embedded in a parent recipe detail view.

conflict_risks: No overlap with other in-progress beads; RecipeBottomBar.swift is a new file with no edits to existing files.
